title: ScoreboardPlus
description: ScoreboardPlus is a Minecraft plugin that lets admins create and manage animated, placeholder-enabled sidebar scoreboards with multiple profiles and per-world assignments, using commands or a GUI.
body:
#  **ScoreboardPlus**

ScoreboardPlus is a Paper/Spigot plugin that renders a sidebar scoreboard per player with support for multiple profiles and per‑world mapping. Each profile has its own title and lines, with a configurable maximum of up to 15 lines. A default profile is always available, and worlds can be mapped to a specific profile or set to `none` to disable the scoreboard in that world.

Text supports `&` color codes, hex colors (`&#RRGGBB`), and an animated `rainbow:` effect. Built‑in placeholders include:
`%player%`, `%displayname%`, `%online%`, `%max%`, `%world%`, `%ping%`, `%health%`, `%food%`, `%x%`, `%y%`, `%z%`.
If PlaceholderAPI is installed, its placeholders are applied as well.

Admins can edit everything via `/psb` commands or the in‑game GUI editor. The GUI lets you:
- select profiles
- edit title and lines
- move lines up/down
- duplicate or delete lines
- clear all lines
Chat input is used for text entry, and `cancel` aborts an edit.

Scoreboards update automatically on player join, world change, and on a configurable animation tick interval.
